notes.subject: tsedek
notes.rationale: צדקתי em i tsedek bilong Yahwe, tanim tok long Tok Pisin 'stret pasin' bai bagarapim nem bilong tok Hibru, olsem na mi holim tsedek

notes.subject: תפארתי לישראל
notes.rationale: 'glori bilong mi bilong Yisrael' — KJV/JPS: glori bilong Israel; BSB: mi hamamasim Yisrael wantaim glori bilong mi; Hebri i tok 'tapar bilong mi' wantaim 'bilong Yisrael'

notes.subject: long ol man hatpela bel bilong Yisrael
notes.rationale: Yahwe i tokim ol man i stap longwe long tsedek (46:12), tok i go stret long ol

translation: Mi bringim klostu tsedek bilong mi, em i no ken go longwe, na selimaut bilong mi i no ken weited long taim; na bai mi putim selimaut long Tsiyon, na bilong Yisrael glori bilong mi.
